title: Egyptian Navy Autonomous INTelligence System (AINTS) Platform Integration
description: The Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWAR) HQ, in support of the Program Executive Office (PEO) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C41) International Integration Program Office (PMW 740) is issuing this Request for Proposal (RFP) N0003926RE014 to procure Autonomous INTelligence System (AINTS) platforms and capabilities to enhance the operational system and mission for the Egyptian Navy (EN) per Foreign Military Sales (FMS) case EG-P-LGQ. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code assigned to this acquisition is 334511, Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing (size standard $10 million dollars).This is a new requirement to award a contract for the design, engineering, procurement, integration, testing, installation, training, and FSR services of the Egypt AINTS Platform Integration using full and open competition. The period of performance for this contract will be three (3) years. This contract will include Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) Line Item Numbers (CLINs) for labor, Cost-Reimbursement, non-fee bearing CLINs for travel/other direct costs (ODCs), and Firm-Fixed-Price CLINs for Material/Equipment/Spares. Contract award is estimated between June 2027 - June 2030. The Government will not pay for any effort expended in response to this notice. Any information submitted in response to this RFP will become property of the U.S. Government. All questions/comments are to be submitted in writing to Ms. Kristin White, Contracting Officer, at kristin.l.white4.civ@us.navy.mil and Ms. Kimberly Ellis, Contracts Specialist, at kimberly.a.ellis10.civ@us.navy.mil. The specific requirements for this RFP will include Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and will not be made publicly available. In order to obtain access to the CUI document (RFP Attachment 1-SOW), interested parties will need to submit a signed Company Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) for each prime/sub requiring access to the non-public document. If an Offeror has previously submitted an NDA for this procurement, a new NDA will not need to be re-submitted unless there are changes to the previous submission. Only one NDA per Company (Prime/Sub) is required at this time. Note: Please make sure your cage code is included and all sections of the NDA is completed in order to not cause a delay in receiving access. Currently the CUI Limited Dissemination Control List only allows for Department of Defense (DoD) and U.S. DoD Contractors only. Interested parties should submit the attached NDA to Kristin White at kristin.l.white4.civ@us.navy.mil and Kimberly Ellis at kimberly.a.ellis10.civ@us.navy.mil. To minimize the volume of individual submissions, interested parties shall designate a single Point of Contact to collect and submit the required NDAs for the Prime/Sub teaming to the Government on behalf of the Prime Company. Future information, if released, will be posted on the Solicitation module in the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) application and Contract Opportunities at https://sam.gov. title: Hoisting & Rigging Equipment Support Services
description: Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory is looking to acquires PPPL personnel perform much of the routine required inspections; however, during peak workload periods and for large repairs, the Subcontractor may be called upon on to perform these tasks. This SOW provides the requirements for subcontracted periodic inspections. It also addresses the assignment to a Subcontractor of the requirement to perform remedial (corrective) maintenance, which may be determined necessary based upon the periodic inspections, in order to make a piece of equipment operable in accordance with governing codes and standards, and the performance of routine maintenance as recommended by the various equipment manufacturers. Unless specified and agreed to otherwise in writing, PPPL requires that the work be performed in accordance with the manufacturer specifications and procedures. After any maintenance is performed, a complete thorough check of equipment function shall be performed including all safety features and interlocks as described by the manufacturer. Additionally, the Subcontractor may be called upon for advice for crane upgrades and performance enhancements. Several large cranes (Items 3, 13, 33, 34 on Attachment A) are retrofitted with Catron/Electromotive radio remote controls and Variable Frequency Drives. Familiarity with and qualification in maintenance and adjustments of these cranes and control systems is mandatory. Subcontractor's membership in the Crane Manufacturers Association of America (CMAA) is regarded as highly desirable, and a measure of the Subcontractor's professionalism and technical qualification for performing tasks such as assigned under the Statement of Work.PPPL does not guarantee any minimum level of work and reserves the right to use other sources to perform the inspection and maintenance tasks when PPPL determines this to be appropriate A mandatory preproposal zoom meeting has been scheduled for 1:30 PM on 8 Oct 2026. title: CO NP ROMO 407(1) Holzwarth Culvert
description: SOLICITATION ID: 6982AF27B000004 PROJECT NUMBER: CO FTNP ROMO 407(1) PROJECT NAME: Holzwarth Culvert PROJECT DESCRIPTION: This project will replace the deficient Holzwarth Culvert (Structure No. 1520-029S), a six-barrel corrugated metal arch pipe culvert on the Holzwarth Access Road with a steel girder bridge. Located in Rocky Mountain National Park, approximately nine miles north of Grand Lake, CO, along US HWY 34 at an elevation of 8,900 feet, the culvert conveys flow from the Colorado River and provides access to the Holzwarth Historic Site. The purpose of this project is to prevent future roadway damage and flooding while maintaining access to employee housing, the historic site, and National Park Service and Forest Service recreation opportunities. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The project will consist of removal of the existing six barrel culvert and construction of a new steel girder bridge with a cast in place concrete deck. New bridge abutments and micropiles. Temporary stream diversion and riprap. New aggregate roadway surfacing. Relocation of an existing electrical line. Relocation of existing historic head gates into a new concrete slab. The site is accessible on foot a quarter mile past the locked gate at the south end of the Holzwarth Historic Site Parking Lot and along the Holzwarth Culvert Access Road. The Holzwarth Culvert Access Road is approximately 13� wide with tight turns. Temporary widening will be necessary to prevent truck off tracking on to sensitive environmental resources. A temporary truck turnaround will also be necessary as no construction access is allowed more than 100� west of the bridge. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 70Z03826RB0000006 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ). This solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) effective as of November 28, 2025. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 336413. The small business size standard is 1,250 employees. This is being solicited on a sole source basis. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which shall be considered by the agency. The United States Coast Guard (USCG), Aviation Logistics Center (ALC), Elizabeth City, NC intends to award an Indefinite Delivery Requirements type contract to BAE Systems Land & Armaments, L.P. (BAE) of Phoenix, AZ. This requirement will be solicited on an other than full and open competition basis under the authority of FAR 12.102 (b) for the procurement of spare parts for the pilot, co-pilot, and mechanic aircraft seats on the MH-65E Aircraft. BAE (Cage Code 54786) is the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and the only distributor source in North America capable of providing the required parts in the Schedule. The contract will consist of a one-year base period and if exercised, up to four (4) one-year option periods. This contract shall not exceed five (5) years. See the following attached documents titled: �Attachment 1 � Schedule of Supplies 70Z03826RB0000006�, �Attachment 2 � Provisions, Clauses, and Terms and Conditions 70Z03826RB0000006�, and �Attachment 3 - Redacted J and A � 70Z03826RB0000006�. Concerns having the expertise and required capabilities to provide these items are invited to submit offers in accordance with the requirements stipulated in this solicitation. Parts must be approved in accordance with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) guidelines to ensure safety of our aircrew. The Government shall ensure all procurements are awarded without jeopardizing quality or safety of flight. Only the use of airworthy commercial specifications or standard military specifications/military standard parts will be utilized and approved from this solicitation. Newly manufactured commercial items will only be procured from sources able to provide a Certificate of Conformance (COC) and traceability to the OEM. The Federal Aviation Regulation, Part 21, outlines certification procedures. The contractor shall furnish a Certificate of Conformance (COC) in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) clause 52.246-15. Certificate of conformance must be submitted in the format specified in the clause. All parts shall be NEW approved parts. Offerors must be able to provide necessary certification including traceability to the manufacturer, manufacturer's COC and its own COC to ensure parts are in airworthy condition, suitable for installation on USCG aircraft. Prospective vendors who are not the OEM or an authorized distributor must provide traceability for the offered product back to the manufacturer or authorized distributor. Traceability means a clear, complete, documented, and auditable paper trail which traces each step from an OEM or distributor to its current location. Traceability to the OEM must have only two exchanges prior to USCG delivery. Alternate parts will not be authorized. NO SUBSTITUTE PARTS WILL BE CONSIDERED. ONLY NEW PARTS WILL BE ACCEPTED. The Government reserves the right to withhold any item or group of items contained in this solicitation upon award. The Government reserves the right to make a single award, to make multiple awards covering different subsets of CLINs, or to make no award. The Government shall assume, for the purpose of making multiple awards, that $500 would be the administrative cost to the Government for issuing and administering each contract awarded under this solicitation. Individual awards shall be for the items or combinations of items that result in the lowest cost to the Government including the assumed administrative costs. The government shall ensure all procurements are awarded without jeopardizing quality or safety of flight. NOTE: NO DRAWINGS, SPECIFICATIONS OR SCHEMATICS ARE AVAILABLE FROM THIS AGENCY. Closing date and time for receipt of offers is 9 March 2026 at 4:30 pm EDT. Any quotation received after the closing date and time specified are considered late. E-mailed quotations are required and shall be sent to Livia.M.Pippen@uscg.mil. Please indicate solicitation 70Z03826RB0000006 in the subject line. Phone call quotations WILL NOT be accepted.

title: Nationwide Flexible Coworking Services
description: SOURCES SOUGHT Nationwide Flexible Coworking Services for GSA, PBS. Sources Sought Response Date: October 20th, 2026 4pm CST The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 531120 - Lessors of nonresidential buildings (except miniwarehouses). This Sources Sought Notice is a market research tool being utilized to determine interest and capability of potential sources prior to issuing a formal solicitation, as the solicitation is not available at this time. This IS NOT a Request for Offerors or Proposals. This notice does not represent a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government to a particular acquisition approach. This is a Sources Sought Announcement for planning purposes only. Market research is being conducted to determine if there are businesses with the requisite capabilities and experience to perform the required work. In addition, this market research is to determine if there are respondents that qualify under one or more socio-economic indicators, including but not limited to, small business, woman-owned business, Women Owned Small business (WOSB), Economically Disadvantaged Women Owned Small business (EDWOSB), Veteran Owned Small business, Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small business, SBA Certified Small Disadvantaged business, SBA Certified 8(a) Firm, SBA Certified HUBZone Firm. The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) anticipates procuring the services of multiple contractors to perform Flexible Coworking Services, either as shared co-working spaces (Standard coworking spaces where an organization shares the space with other individuals and organizations) or private co-working spaces (Coworking spaces where a certain area (floor, section, private offices with locks) is dedicated to a single organization for federal agencies looking to occupy a coworking space with other federal or private sector employees. It is the intention of GSA to award a multiple contractor, Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract. Description of Services: The firm shall be able to provide flexible coworking space nationwide. The firm shall have an online booking system where Government employees can quickly select a workspace from an online system and/or from a mobile phone application. In addition to having access to both private and shared offices and workstations, Government employees should be able to utilize a meeting room on an hourly or daily basis. The space should be able, if necessary, to be segregated from certain parts of the vendor�s general operations, or at times operate autonomously. The firm shall provide management for each location. Management duties include, but are not limited to providing, uninterrupted internet, office support, oversight for the online booking platform, monthly usage reports to GSA, and billing based on actual usage. Specific management services may vary per location and are subject to localized requirements and offerings. Management does not include IT support for government furnished equipment. Commercial contracting approaches from RFO Part 12 apply to these requirements. If interested in responding to this Sources Sought, please respond by completing and submitting the GSA Flexible Coworking Services Sources Sought Questionnaire no later than 4:00pm Central Standard Time on Tuesday, October 20th, 2026. NO TELEPHONE CALLS WILL BE ACCEPTED. QUESTIONS ARE NOT PERMITTED. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL OR SOLICITATION.

title: Nouveau développement du sM-client
description:
Le sM-Client (sedex Message Client) est une application middleware développée sur mandat de la Conférence suisse des impôts (CSI) et de l'Office fédéral des assurances sociales (OFAS) pour l'échange de messages sedex selon la norme eCH-0058; elle est en exploitation productive depuis plus de 15 ans auprès de plus de 150 participants sedex des domaines sedex CSI et OFAS.

 

Étant donné qu'une refonte complète de cette application est prévue, le présent appel d'offres vise à trouver un prestataire capable de fournir les services suivants :


• Développement initial de la nouvelle application dans le cadre d'un contrat d'entreprise. Le prestataire agit en tant qu'entreprise générale et assume la responsabilité globale de la réalisation de la nouvelle application, y compris l'ensemble des prestations de projet telles que l'élaboration du cahier des charges détaillé, respectivement des user stories (y compris la maquette GUI à valider), l'architecture de solution, le document de base SIPD, la gestion des tests, la formation et la documentation.


• Prestations de développement continu, de maintenance et de support après la réception de la solution, sur une période de 4 ans (+ 2 × 2 années supplémentaires en option), dans le cadre d'un contrat de prestations de services, y compris le support pour l'installation initiale.


Le prestataire doit également offrir l'ensemble des exigences désignées comme options (notamment les options de prolongation pour la maintenance/le support). Les options prises en compte dans le calcul des prix et l'évaluation de l'utilité figurent dans la feuille de saisie des prix

title: Germany – Demolition, site preparation and clearance work – Evangelisches Klinikum Gelsenkirchen Neubau Psychiatrie - Abbrucharbeiten
description: Die geplante Abbruchmaßnahme dient der Baufeldfreimachung für einen Erweiterungsbau des ev. Klinikum Gelsenkirchen. Dies umfasst den Abbruch des ehemaligen Amtsgericht Gelsenkirchen (3- bzw. 5-geschossiger Baukörper mit Walm-/Satteldach bzw. Flachdach) sowie einem angrenzenden 2-geschossigem Anstaltsgebäude mit verschiedenen Anbauten. Des weiteren befindet sich auf dem Gelände ein ebenfalls abzubrechender unterirdischer ehem. Luftschutzraum (Bunkeranlage) aus dem 2. Weltkrieg. Das abzubrechende Bauvolumen beträgt gesamt ca. 60.000 m3 (BRI). Die Gebäudekörper des ehemaligen Amtsgerichts sind teilweise unterkellert und grenzen unmittelbar an den Straßenraum (Gehweg und Straße) der Overwegstraße an. Die Gebäude sind zu unterschiedlichen Zeiten errichtet worden, das ehem. Amtsgericht (Altbau) zur Jahrhundertwende bzw. der Anbau nach dem 2. Weltkrieg, teilweise unterkellert und in einigen Bereichen einsturzgefährdet. In einigen Bereichen der Baukörper muss der fachgerechte Ausbau und die bestimmungsgemäße Entsorgung verschiedener schadstoffhaltiger Abbruchmaterialien wie Asbest, PCB, KMF, etc. erfolgen. Der gesamte Abbruch erfolgt im innerstädtischen Umfeld mit unmittelbar angrenzender Nachbarbebauung und stellt somit hohe Anforderung an den Ablauf und die Logistik der Abbrucharbeiten.

title: Germany – Integrated telecommunications services – UCaaS-Lösung
description: Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit einer vorgesehenen Laufzeit von 60 Monaten über die Bereitstellung, Implementierung, Migration, den Betrieb und die Unterstützung einer konzernweit nutzbaren UCaaS-Lösung. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere die benötigten UCaaS- und Contact-Center-Funktionen, zugehörige Basis-Infrastrukturen und Betriebsoptionen sowie Implementierungs-, Migrations-, Service- und Unterstützungsleistungen. Die aus der Rahmenvereinbarung abrufbaren Leistungen werden in der Angebotsphase in einem verbindlichen Leistungs- und Preiswarenkorb abgebildet. Die dort enthaltenen Leistungspositionen dienen der einheitlichen Angebotskalkulation und bilden die Grundlage späterer Einzelabrufe. Die detaillierten funktionalen, technischen, betrieblichen und vertraglichen Anforderungen werden in den Vergabeunterlagen der Angebotsphase innerhalb des bereits bekannt gemachten Auftragsgegenstands beschrieben. Die Rahmenvereinbarung wird ohne Aufteilung in Lose vergeben. Der öffentliche Teilnahmewettbewerb dient der Prüfung der Ausschlussgründe, der Eignung und der Auswahl der Bewerber, die zur anschließenden Angebots- und Verhandlungsphase eingeladen werden. Eine vorausgegangene Beteiligung an einer etwaigen Markterkundung oder Interessenbekundung begründet weder ein Teilnahmeprivileg noch eine zusätzliche Teilnahmevoraussetzung. title: Germany – Structural steelworks – Stahlbauarbeiten
description: TP C - Ausstellungsneuplanung und -erweiterung im Alten Turm der KWG Art und Umfang des Bauvorhabens Die Leitidee der Neugestaltung und Erweiterung der Ausstellung im Alten Turm ist die Reduktion der Bauelemente im Inneren zugunsten einer Verstärkung der bestehenden Atmosphäre. Das Hauptausstellungsobjekt ist dabei die Ruine des Alten Turms selbst. Statt neuer, dominierender architektonischer Eingriffe ist konzeptionell die Öffnung der nach Kriegsende hinzugekommenen und die Atmosphäre störenden Einbauten vorgesehen. Das skulpturale Denkmal soll zu einem begehbaren Mahnmal mit einer außergewöhnlichen räumlichen Licht- und Klanginszenierung weiterentwickelt werden, wobei der Ruinencharakter des Gebäudes betont wird. Die Inszenierung soll die Dramatik der Kriegsschäden "offen zeigen" und ein Erleben des Bauwerks durch die Elemente Licht, Wasser, Wind und Klang ermöglichen. Zweck und Notwendigkeit der Baumaßnahmen sind die nachhaltige Sicherung, sowie die Verbesserung der nationalen und internationalen Wahrnehmbarkeit der historischen und gegenwärtigen Bedeutung des denkmalgeschützten Ensembles.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Generalsanierung Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule Mühlacker, TWP
description: Die Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule in Mühlacker bereitet sich auf eine umfassende Neuausrichtung vor, um den Anforderungen der kommenden Jahrzehnte gerecht zu werden. Als zentraler Bildungs- und Lebensraum im Stadtteil Dürrmenz muss die Schule auf den tiefgreifenden Wandel in der Bildungslandschaft und veränderte ge-sellschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen reagieren. Ursprünglich als kombinierte Grund- und Hauptschule dimensio-niert, wird der Komplex heute als reine Grundschule geführt. Um den zukünftigen Anforderungen an eine zeit-gemäße Pädagogik, Chancengleichheit und die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf gerecht zu werden, soll der Standort planerisch vollständig neu konzipiert werden: Ziel ist die Entwicklung zu einer modernen, durchgehend vierzügigen Grundschule mit einem voll integrierten Ganztagsbetrieb. Dieser Schritt sichert langfristig eine hoch-wertige Lernumgebung und schafft die räumlichen Voraussetzungen für moderne, rhythmisierte Bildungsange-bote. Die Ulrich von Dürrmenz Schule in Mühlacker besteht aus einem heterogenen Gebäudekomplex, der zwei bau-lich völlig unterschiedliche Epochen vereint: dem historischen Altbau aus dem Jahr ca. 1885 und einem Erweite-rungsbau inklusive Zwischenbau aus dem Jahr 1968. Beide Gebäudeteile sind baulich, energetisch und technisch stark in die Jahre gekommen. Die Technische Gebäu-deausrüstung (TGA) sowie die Elektrotechnik (ELT) sind veraltet und durch punktuelle Teilsanierungen der ver-gangenen Jahrzehnte fragmentiert. Zudem weisen die Bestandsgebäude erhebliche Barrieren auf. Die starren Raumstrukturen entsprechen weder den Anforderungen an einen modernen, inklusiven Unterricht noch den logistischen Abläufen eines zeitgemä-ßen Schul- und Ganztagesbetriebs. Die bestehenden Freianlagen der Ulrich-von-Dürrmenz-Schule weisen derzeit nur eine eingeschränkte Nut-zungs- und Aufenthaltsqualität auf. Der Schulhof präsentiert sich überwiegend als große, zusammenhängende und asphaltierte Fläche mit geringem gestalterischem Differenzierungsgrad. Altersgerechte Spiel-, Bewegungs- und Aufenthaltsbereiche für die unterschiedlichen Nutzergruppen sind nur in begrenztem Umfang vorhanden. Die Ausstattung der Außenanlagen beschränkt sich im Wesentlichen auf einzelne Sitzbänke entlang der Randbe-reiche sowie die vorhandenen, überdachten Pausengänge im Bereich der Gebäudezugänge. Darüber hinaus be-stehen bauliche Mängel in den Freianlagen. Insbesondere die Außentreppe an der Nordseite ist infolge von Ge-ländesetzungen in ihrer Verkehrssicherheit beeinträchtigt und kann nicht mehr uneingeschränkt genutzt wer-den. Zur Verbesserung des Komforts sind darüber hinaus mehrere überdachte Unterstellmöglichkeiten mit inte-grierten Sitzgelegenheiten als Sonnen- und Regenschutz zu schaffen sein. Weitere Informationen entnehmen Sie der Maßnahmenbeschreibung des Verfahrensleitfadens.

Innerhalb des Klinikgeländes im Neuenheimer Feld im laufenden Klinikbetrieb des Universitätsklinikums Heidelberg, auf dem Gelände um die alte Kinderklinik. In dem neuen Herzzentrum werden die Kardiologie, die Angiologie, die Herzchirurgie, die pädiatrische Kardiologie, die Kinderherzchirurgie sowie die Kardio-Anästhesie des Universitätsklinikums Heidelberg zusammengeführt. title: Germany – Construction work – Umbau, Sanierung und Erweiterung Grundschule am Harrl - Zimmererarbeiten Phase 4
description: Das Schulgebäude ist ein ca. 1876 erbauter historischer Massivbau, unterkellert und 4- geschossig. Das Schulgebäude ist als Baudenkmal nach § 3 Abs. 2 NDSchG eingestuft. Das Hauptgebäude enthält die Unterrichts-, Gruppen- und Differenzierungsräume, die Verwaltung, Mehrzweckräume sowie Nebenräume. Im UG befindet sich neben Lager- und Technikräumen ein Werkraum sowie eine Lehrküche, diese Nutzungen sollen im Zuge des Umbaus ertüchtigt werden. In der Phase 1 wurde ein drittes Treppenhaus über alle Geschosse und ein Mensaneubau (mit Musikräumen im 2.OG) errichtet. In der Phase 2 wurde das 3.OG (ehemalige Hausmeisterwohnung und der nicht genutzte Dachboden) zu Schulräumen umgenutzt und eine Lüftungsanlage im Dachboden eingebaut. Die Sanierung der Sanitärkerne mit Erstellung von neuen Steigesträngen erfolgte ebenfalls in Phase 2. Die Sanitärkerne und das 2.OG (Phase 3) sind derzeit noch Baustellenbereich. Ursprünglich sollte das Schulgebäude im laufenden Betrieb in den nächsten Jahren abschnittsweise saniert, umgebaut und erweitert werden. Damit die restlichen Geschosse unabhängig vom Schulbetrieb fertiggestellt werden können, wird der komplette Schulbetrieb ausgelagert. Voraussichtlich kann nach den Herbstferien 2026 die restliche Sanierung starten. In diesem Bauabschnitt (Phase 4) soll das 1. OG/ EG und der Rest des Kellergeschosses in einem Zuge saniert werden. Hinweis: Bei allen Abbrucharbeiten sind Feuerlöscher in unmittelbarer Nähe bereitzuhalten.

title: Switzerland – Engineering services – Veloroute Hegi, Talacker- bis Solarstrasse, Neubau - Bauingenieurleistungen
description: Das Projekt umfasst den Neubau einer rund 1.1 km langen, durchgängigen Fuss- und Veloroute von der Talacker- bis zur Solarstrasse. Die Route verläuft nördlich der Bahnlinie und führt über SBB- und Industrieareale sowie teils bestehende, anzupassende Rad- und Gehwege. Das Trassee besteht aus einer 4.30 m breiten Fahrbahn mit rot eingefärbtem Belag für den Veloverkehr sowie einem 2.00 bis 2.50 m breiten Fussweg. Dieser wird chaussiert ausgeführt und durch einen schräggestellten Stein von der Velofahrbahn abgetrennt. Die Seenerstrasse wird mit einer neuen, 23.50 m langen und 7.50 m breiten Stahlbetonbrücke überquert. Die als Rahmenkonstruktion ausgebildete Brücke lehnt sich optisch an die benachbarte SBB-Brücke. Das Regenwasser versickert grösstenteils seitlich in angrenzende Grünstreifen und die gesamte Route wird mit nordseitig platzierten Kandelabern beleuchtet. Im Rahmen des Projekts werden Werkleitungsprojekte umgesetzt.

This information can be found at: https://www.doi.gov/pam/acquisition/policy/constructioncontract. (vi) All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency. title: Low Profile Mast and Rotational Module Component Prototype Other Transaction Area of Interest
description: *9.23.2026: Updated Attachment 1: TOU to correct the listed PCO within the document. Team Submarines, Australia, United Kingdom, and United States (AUKUS), International & Systems (AI&S), Submarine Electromagnetic Systems Program Office (PMS 435) is pleased to release a competitive Area of Interest (AOI) announcement for the Low Profile Mast (LPM) and Rotational Module (RM) component to address several key operational needs. The LPM/RM programs seek innovative technologies that accelerate the prototyping of capabilities that address these key operational needs. To accelerate the design, development and demonstration of LPM/RM capabilities, the Navy will be utilizing the Other Transaction Authority pathway outlined in Title 10 U.S.C. � 4022. It is intended that this solicitation may result in the award of one or more prototype projects. There are nine (9) attachments to this AOI, some of which contain Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI): LPM/RM Terms of Use Agreement AOI AOI Guidance CUI LPM Type 24 Mod 1Top-Level Requirements Document [RESTRICTED] CUI LPM Verification Guide (VG) [RESTRICTED] CUI RM Top-Level Requirements Document [RESTRICTED] CUI RM Verification Guide [RESTRICTED] LPM/RM AOI Questions Form CUI LPM/RM Placemat Template [RESTRICTED] Companies are advised to proceed with the following steps to respond to this notice: STEP 1 � Terms of Use Agreement (TOU) Several key documents related to the LPM Type 24 Mod 1 and RM are only releasable to eligible businesses with ownership in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia. Non-Australia, United Kingdom, or United States foreign-owned businesses may submit a technical solution as part of a teaming arrangement with one or more Australia, United Kingdom, or United States-owned businesses. The ability to be awarded an Agreement may depend upon the ability of the Foreign-owned business to obtain necessary clearances and approvals to obtain access to restricted information. Companies interested in submitting a technical solution in response to the AOI shall complete Attachment 1: TOU Agreement and return it via e-mail to the Agreements Officer and Agreements Specialists listed in this notice. The Company point of contact that will request access to the restricted documents in this notice shall be the Company point of contact listed in the TOU. Companies should also request access to the restricted CUI documents in SAM at the time of TOU submittal to the Government. Once the signed TOU is received and verified, Team Submarines will grant access to the restricted CUI documents and transmit relevant UNCLASSIFIED Government-Furnished Information (GFI) to the Company point of contact listed in the TOU. NOTE: The TOU provided as Attachment 1 is specific to this AOI release; if a Company previously submitted a TOU under prior LPM/RM Industry Day notice, that Company must submit a separate TOU for this AOI opportunity. STEP 2 � QUESTIONS & ANSWERS OPPORTUNITY Companies may submit questions using Attachment 8: LPM/RM AOI Questions Form. Team Submarine will only accept Q&A submissions up to the CUI level. Q&A submissions shall be submitted electronically via e-mail to the Government points of contact listed in this notice no later than 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 2, 2026. -SUBJECT: N00024-26-R-6215 Q&A This opportunity is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, nor will the Government reimburse respondents for any questions submitted or for the information provided in response to this notice. The Government may or may not respond to Q&A submissions and reserves the right to redact the content of submissions prior to any release back to industry. The Government may use the information and feedback provided in Q&A submissions to inform future solicitations as necessary. Respondents are solely responsible for properly marking and clearly identifying any proprietary information or trade secrets contained in any submission in response to this notice. Opting not to submit any Q&A does not preclude participation in this AOI or any future engagements. It is the responsibility of industry to monitor the Government Point of Entry (GPE) for official AOI communications. STEP 4 - Companies shall submit Phase I White Papers and Placemats electronically via encrypted DoD SAFE transmission. Companies must request a DoD SAFE link by e-mailing ALL Government points contract listed in this notice no later than 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 13, 2026. -SUBJECT: [insert LPM or RM] N00024-26-R-6215 DoD SAFE Link [insert COMPANY NAME] If a Company intends to send a Phase I submission for both LPM and RM, that Company must request two separate DoD SAFE links. Companies are encouraged to submit White Papers prior to the latest closing date. Inclusion of a delivery receipt with an email submission will be the only indication of the Government�s successful receipt of a White Paper. Each Company must comply with DoD SAFE file size limitations and other guidance as provided at https://safe.apps.mil/. Phase I submissions must be received by the Government via encrypted DoD SAFE submission no later than 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 20, 2026. GOVERNMENT POINTS OF CONTACT: Agreements Officer - Ms. Caryl Williams � caryl.a.williams.civ@us.navy.mil Agreements Specialist - Ms. Jada Williams � jada.n.williams11.civ@us.navy.mil Agreements Specialist - Ms. Alaina Fletcher � alaina.s.fletcher.civ@us.navy.mil NOTE: For Companies invited to participate in Phase II only, the Government will distribute CLASSIFIED TLRD Annex(es) to Companies eligible to receive CLASSIFIED data and may elect to release additional information. HARD COPIES OF MAILED OR HAND DELIVERED WHITE PAPERS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. Submissions sent through other channels not identified in this Notice, or after the Phase I White Paper submission deadline, will not be reviewed nor evaluated by the Government. DEADLINES: Q&A: by 6:00 p.m. ET on October 2, 2026 DoD SAFE Link Request: by 6:00 p.m. ET on October 13, 2026 Phase I Submission: by 6:00 p.m. ET on October 20, 2026

(i) The Department of Interior, USGS/Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center, Sioux Falls, South Dakota is seeking professional firms to provide construction to remove and replace chilled water piping and condenser water piping which serves the 1996 building addition at EROS. Location is the USGS/EROS Science Center, 47914 252nd Street, Sioux Falls SD 57198. A design to upgrade the system was completed as a result on 6/12/2020 titled Earth Resources Observation and Science Center Phase 1: EROS Fluid Coolers Design Services (Attachment 2). The 6/12/2020 as built drawings are included in Attachment 3 along with the mechanical system design criteria (Attachment 4). Due to cost constraints, the design, drawings and mechanical design attachments are provided for reference and basis of design only. Removal and replacement of cooling towers have been completed. The third chiller will not be completed under this contract. Design reference documents to illustrate prior design intent and existing conditions. Only the requirements specifically identified in the Statement of Work constitute the contractually binding scope. (ii) Procedures in accordance with FAR 12.201-1 Simplified procedures. The anticipated award date is November 4, 2027. (iii) N/A (iv) Technical data will be furnished as attachments to this solicitation. This information can be found at: https://www.doi.gov/pam/acquisition/policy/constructioncontract. title: Iceland – Street-lighting maintenance services – Street lighting maintenance and service in Gardabaer Iceland
description: Gardabaer Municipality seeks offers for the procurement of maintenance services for the municipal street lighting system. The maintenance services is for street lighting within the municipality, covering areas serviced by both HS Veitur and Veitur utilities. The street lighting network consists of distribution cabinets, underground cables, poles, and lamps, as well as lighting systems in underpasses and related infrastructure within the municipal boundaries. The infrastructure currently comprises approximately 6,000 municipality-owned lamps and 5,900 poles (with roughly 25% of poles exceeding a height of 6.3 meters). The system integrates with 53 service connection cabinets equipped with relevant protection and control gear, alongside 39 branch cabinets.

description: a)- Una relación de las obras ejecutadas en el curso de los últimos cinco años, que sean del mismo grupo o subgrupo de clasificación que el correspondiente al contrato (C 4) avalada por certificados de buena ejecución; estos certificados indicarán el importe, las fechas, y el lugar de ejecución de las obras y se precisará si se realizaron según las reglas por las que se rige la profesión y se llevaron normalmente a buen término; en su caso, dichos certificados serán comunicados directamente al órgano de contratación por la autoridad competente. El importe anual acumulado que el empresario deberá acreditar como ejecutado durante el año de mayor ejecución del periodo citado (5 últimos años) será de un importe igual o superior al 70% de valor estimado del contrato. b)- En caso de que el contratista sea una empresa de nueva creación, entendiendo por tal aquella que tenga una antigüedad inferior a cinco años, la solvencia técnica se acreditará a través de las titulaciones académicas y profesionales del personal técnico responsable directamente de las obras, del que se especificará nombre y apellidos. Este personal deberá poseer la titulación de Arquitecto, Aparejador, Arquitecto Técnico o Ingeniero de la edificación, debiendo aportar copia del certificado de inscripción en el Colegio Profesional pertinente. Para acreditar la solvencia necesaria el empresario podrá basarse en la solvencia y medios de otras entidades, independientemente de la naturaleza jurídica de los vínculos que tenga con ellas, siempre que demuestre que durante toda la ejecución del contrato dispondrá efectivamente de esa solvencia y medios, y que la entidad a la que recurre no está incursa en una prohibición de contratar. Si el licitador ha recurrido a las capacidades de otras empresas, deberá aportar también la documentación de estas empresas referida en los apartados anteriores y el compromiso por escrito de las mismas que demuestre que efectivamente disponen de la solvencia y de los medios declarados para la ejecución del contrato. (Artículo 75 LCSP). En cuanto a la acreditación de la solvencia económica y financiera, deberán aportar, además, el compromiso de asumir de forma solidaria la responsabilidad de la ejecución del contrato. En las UTE, a efectos de determinación de su solvencia, se acumularán las características acreditadas para cada uno de sus integrantes. (Artículo 24.1 del RGLCAP)

description: Una relación de los principales servicios o trabajos realizados de igual o similar naturaleza que los que constituyen el objeto del contrato en el curso de los últimos 3 años avalada por certificados de buena ejecución. Los trabajos efectuados se acreditarán mediante certificados expedidos o visados por el órgano competente, cuando el destinatario sea una entidad del sector público; cuando el destinatario sea un sujeto privado, mediante un certificado expedido por éste o, a falta de este certificado, mediante una declaración del empresario acompañado de los documentos obrantes en poder del mismo que acrediten la realización de la prestación. Estos documentos deberán indicar la descripción de los trabajos realizados, el importe (IVA excluido), la fecha, y el destinatario, público o privado de los mismos. Se considerará que el empresario cuenta con solvencia técnica acreditada por este medio cuando de la relación presentada, el año de mayor ejecución incluya servicios ejecutados por un importe igual o superior al 70 % del valor estimado del presente contrato. Para determinar que un servicio o trabajo es de igual o similar naturaleza a la que constituye el objeto del contrato se acudirá a los dos primeros dígitos del CPV. Empresas de nueva creación: en los contratos no sujetos a regulación armonizada, cuando el contratista sea una empresa de nueva creación, entendiendo por tal, aquella que tenga una antigüedad inferior a 5 años, su solvencia técnica se acreditará por uno o varios de los medios a que se refieren las letras b) a i) del artículo 90.1 LCSP, sin que en ningún caso sea aplicable lo establecido en la letra a) del mismo artículo, relativo a la ejecución de un número determinado de trabajos o servicios.

title: Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – Inhuur flexwerkers voor diverse Midwaste-leden
description: Aanbestedende dienst CV Midwaste Milieu UA (Midwaste) Poortweg 4 B 2612PA Delft Opdrachtgevers De Opdrachtgevers in deze aanbesteding zijn: - Afvalcombinatie 'De Vallei' Gemeenten BV - Afvalstoffendienst 's-Hertogenbosch - Regionaal Reinigingsbedrijf Avalex Den Haag - Dar NV Nijmegen - De Meerlanden Holding NV Rijsenhout - Saver NV Roosendaal Opdrachtomschrijving: Deze aanbesteding betreft een Europese openbare procedure voor de inhuur van flexwerkers ten behoeve van diverse leden van Midwaste. De opdracht omvat het ter beschikking stellen van flexwerkers, waarbij de aard, omvang en duur van de inzet kunnen verschillen per deelnemend Midwaste-lid. De specifieke kenmerken en behoeften worden nader toegelicht per perceel. Binnen deze aanbesteding zijn verschillende cao's van toepassing, afhankelijk van het betreffende Midwaste-lid. Opdrachtnemer houdt bij de uitvoering van de overeenkomst rekening met de voor het betreffende Midwaste-lid geldende cao en past, voor zover wettelijk en contractueel van toepassing, de daaruit voortvloeiende arbeidsvoorwaarden toe. Indien sprake is van overname van personeel, wordt verwacht dat de overgenomen medewerkers aansluiten bij de functie-indeling en loonschalen zoals deze binnen het betreffende Midwaste-lid worden gehanteerd. Doel van de opdracht: Met deze aanbesteding beogen de opdrachtgevers per perceel een duurzame samenwerking aan te gaan met een professionele dienstverlener die flexibel kan voorzien in de personeelsbehoefte van de deelnemende Midwaste-leden. Duur raamovereenkomst: De raamovereenkomsten treden in werking op 1 februari 2027 en hebben een initiële looptijd van twee jaar. Opdrachtgever heeft vervolgens de mogelijkheid de raamovereenkomsten viermaal (4) met een periode van twaalf (12) maanden te verlengen. Voor perceel 3 Afvalstoffendienst 's-Hertogenbosch geldt hierop een uitzondering: voor dit perceel bedraagt de verlengingsmogelijkheid tweemaal (2) een periode van twaalf (12) maanden.

title: Netherlands – Sewage, refuse, cleaning and environmental services – Europese openbare aanbesteding Bestrijden milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen op land en water
description: Europese openbare aanbesteding Bestrijden milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen op land en water. WSRL wil één aanspreekpunt voor milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen. Door het maken van duidelijke afspraken, wordt op eenduidige wijze met het bestrijden van milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen omgegaan. Opdrachtomschrijving De opdracht betreft het op afroep opruimen, inzamelen, transporteren, (laten) opslaan en (laten) verwerken van milieuverontreinigende stoffen en dumpingen op land en water in beheer in het beheergebied van WSRL, bij: Wegen en wegbermen (in Alblasserwaard en Vijfheerenlanden); Waterkeringen; Terreinen in eigendom van WSRL; Watergangen/-vaarwegen. Milieuverontreinigende stoffen zijn stoffen die schade kunnen toebrengen aan de leefomgeving, mens en/of milieu, bijvoorbeeld chemicaliën, oliën (inclusief brandstoffen) en asbestdeeltjes. Dumpingen zijn afvalstoffen die onbeheerd worden aangetroffen, bewust of onbewust (bijvoorbeeld bij een ongeval). Indien sprake is van (water)bodemverontreiniging dient Opdrachtnemer een milieukundig (water)bodemadvies (situationeel inclusief het nemen van waterkwaliteit monsters) uit te brengen waaruit blijkt of sanering op de calamiteitenlocatie noodzakelijk is. Mocht dat aan de orde zijn, dan draagt Opdrachtnemer zorg voor de uitvoering van de sanering. Indien Opdrachtnemer hier zelf niet voor erkend is, schakelt Opdrachtnemer een erkend onderaannemer hiervoor in. Opdrachtnemer is verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat. Het is van belang voor WSRL 24/7 – 365 dagen te beschikken over een gecontracteerde en daarmee gegarandeerde inzet van een Opdrachtnemer voor uitvoering van deze aanbestedingsopdracht. Na de melding van een calamiteit, verwacht WSRL van Inschrijver: 1. Door het stellen van de juiste vragen (doorvragen) aan de melder het zo volledig mogelijk inschatten van de situatie en bepalen van de te nemen maatregelen en in te zetten materieel en personeel; 2. Inschrijver neemt maatregelen om verdere verontreiniging, vervolgschade, uitbreiding en/of ecologische risico’s (risico’s ten aanzien van de leefomgeving, mens en milieu) van de calamiteit te voorkomen (De ter plaatse zijnde medewerker(s) van WSRL (meestal een handhaver) voeren vaak al kleine werkzaamheden uit, zoals oliebooms plaatsen op het water e.d.); 3. Het zorgdragen voor een veilige (verkeers)situatie en werkomgeving. Als het zelfstandig bestrijden van de calamiteit onmogelijk blijkt, moet Inschrijver de calamiteitlocatie alleen veiligstellen tot dat hulpdiensten en/of (andere) gespecialiseerde partijen ter plaatse zijn; 4. Indien de situatie hier om vraagt, voert Opdrachtnemer bij een spoedeisend karakter een milieukundig (water)bodemadvies en bodemsanering uit. Bij geen spoedeisend karakter heeft Opdrachtgever de mogelijkheid via een andere partij deze dienst af te nemen. Van Opdrachtnemer wordt in dat geval geen onderzoek of handeling daartoe vereist (zoals bijvoorbeeld het opstellen van de rapportage). Van spoedeisend karakter is sprake als (de kans op) milieuverontreiniging groter wordt; 5. Het uitvoeren van de werkzaamheden zo snel mogelijk afhandelen zodat het verkeer weer veilig en ongehinderd haar weg kan vervolgen; 6. Indien nodig uitvoeren van spoedeisende herstelwerkzaamheden aan/op de calamiteitenlocatie; 7. Situationeel leveren van schone grond (is grond en bodem dat volgens de huidige wetgeving mag worden toegepast); 8. Het op de juiste wijze afvoeren, transporteren, laten (opslaan) en (laten) verwerken van de milieuverontreinigende stoffen; 9. Opmaken van een opdrachtbevestiging over de calamiteit (24 uurs melding), milieukundig bodemadvies en/of rapportage bij (drugs)dumpingen; 10. Opdrachtgever gedurende de calamiteit en nazorg informeren over de uit te voeren/uitgevoerde calamiteitenbestrijding. Niet binnen de scope behoort: Het verwijderen van explosief en radioactief afval; Opdrachtgever voert het verhalen van schades op de verzekering van deze aanbestedingsopdracht zelf uit. Looptijd Raamovereenkomst Voor het bestrijden van milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen op land en water heeft WSRL het voornemen met één (1) Inschrijver een Raamovereenkomst aan te gaan voor een periode van twee (2) jaar. Optioneel is het mogelijk de Raamovereenkomst met een periode van tweemaal (2) één (1) jaar te verlengen onder gelijkblijvende voorwaarden. WSRL bepaalt uiteindelijk of de Raamovereenkomst al dan niet wordt verlengd. Tevens heeft WSRL de mogelijkheid de Raamovereenkomst eenzijdig te beëindigen. Het beëindigen van de Raamovereenkomst is door WSRL mogelijk als bij evaluatie herhaaldelijk blijkt dat Opdrachtnemer gemaakte afspraken niet naleeft en/of afgesproken kwaliteit niet levert. De Raamovereenkomst heeft daardoor een maximale looptijd van vier (4) jaar en eindigt, zonder dat opzegging vereist is, van rechtswege na het verstrijken van de vier (4) jaar. De ingangsdatum van de Raamovereenkomst is 1 december 2026 of zoveel eerder of later dat Opdrachtgever en Opdrachtnemer overeenkomen.

title: Denmark – Non-scheduled passenger transport – Udbud af kontrakt vedr. morskørsel til dansk politi
description: Dansk Politi udbyder kontrakt vedr. morskørsel. Delt op i fem (5) delaftaler: Delaftale 1: Morskørsel til Nordjyllands- og Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi Delaftale 2: Morskørsel til Østjyllands-, Sydøstjyllands- og Syd- og Sønderjyllands Politi Delaftale 3: Morskørsel til Fyns, Midt- og Vestsjællands og Sydsjælland og Lolland-Falsters Politi Delaftale 4: Morskørsel til Nordsjællands-, Københavns Vestegns- og Københavns Politi Delaftale 5: Morskørsel til Bornholms Politi Dansk politi har behov for kørsel af afdøde personer, der er erklæret for døde, og hvor dødsfaldet er omfattet af indberetningspligten jf. Sundhedslovens § 179, og hvor afdøde ikke ligger til offentligt skue. Kørslen omfatter to typer af kørsler, der skal udføres døgnet- og året rundt: 1. Almindelig morskørsel o Kørsel af afdøde fra opsamlingssted til et af politiets nærmere angivne steder. Dette kan eksempelvis være et kapel, et sygehus eller et retsmedicinsk institut, hvor der skal udføres et retslægeligt ligsyn. 2. Intern kørsel Udgangspunktet for Intern morskørsel er, at de kan planlægges mellem kunden og leverandøren. Intern kørsel bliver relevant i de situationer: o Hvor afdøde forud for dødens konstatering har været indbragt med ambulance til sygehus. Denne kørsel kan foregå mellem sygehus og kapel o Hvor der ved det retslægelige tilsyn vurderes, at der skal foretages obduktion. Denne kørsel består af to kørsler hhv. til retsmedicinsk institut og retur til udgangspunktet.

The instrument shall be integrated in our production line for genotyping with next-generation sequencing (NGS), which is based on two stage PCR methodology. Thus the instrument will primarily be used for the construction of the NGS libraries and preparation of these for sequencing. The tasks that the instrument shall carry out include: i) Transferring DNA-templat, as well as adding master mixers and primers. ii) Cleaning PCR products (e.g. magnetic bullets) iii) Automated ("hands-off") quantification of DNA iv) Individual normalisation of libraries based on DNA concentration v) Merging of libraries The planned flow is 20,000– 30,000 samples per annum in a sample flow that will normally be carried out in 4 x 96 well plates with a reaction volume of 5-20 uL. In the future we envisage that 384 well plates will be a part of the test flow. As the instrument shall be used post-PCR, it is important that the instrument design allows effective cleaning and thorough decontamination. We would like a quick instrument with high capacity, pipetting precision and accuracy - even at low reaction volumes. In addition the robot is required to have great flexibility and an intuitive user interface, so that applications can be created and modified by personnel without advanced programming competence.

Gentofte Kommune ønsker ikke, at normalkost til raske ældre samt energi- og proteinrig kost levereres som frost. Dog kan enkelte komponenter godt leveres som frost, f.eks. grøntsager.

title: Limited Competition Justification and Award Notice Outbound Shipments
description: The purpose of this notice is to comply with posting requirement, FAR Part 5 and Subpart 6.301. Competition was restricted to a limited number of vendors capable of meeting current operational requirements, including the ability to ship via alternative routes. This restriction is necessary due to constraints imposed by ongoing regional instability, which has rendered standard shipping routes unreliable or unavailable. Limiting competition to qualified vendors ensures continuity of outbound shipping services under current conditions. The security situation in the region remains fluid and subject to sudden escalation. Recurring, rapid changes in regional security conditions are affecting carrier availability, shipping routes, transit times, insurance requirements, and overall logistics reliability with little advance notice. Shipping activity through the Strait of Hormuz and other regional transportation corridors is unreliable and dangerous, with a result of limited bookings available from limited shippers In accordance with FAR 12.201-1(c)(2)(ii), simplified acquisition procedures, quotations were solicited from three vendors determined capable of meeting the Government�s requirements under current operational conditions. Three quotations were received and evaluated based on technical capability, compliance with the required scope of services, demonstrated ability to meet urgent logistical and delivery requirements, relevant past performance, and price reasonableness. The selected contractor was determined to represent the lowest-priced technically acceptable quotation $26,206 USD and demonstrated the capability to successfully perform the required services within the required timeframe and operational constraints. The contractor also demonstrated a strong record of relevant past performance supporting U.S. Embassy Kuwait requirements, including reliable and quality performance under similar operational conditions. title: 6515--MC | VISN 15 Path & Lab | NEW ANATOMIC PATHOLOGY WORKFLOW | Base plus 4 | (VA-27-00002252) GS-07F-139CA
description: STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) Anatomic Pathology Specimen Tracking System VISN 15 Pathology and Laboratory Services 1.0 General 1.1 The Contractor shall provide and configure an Anatomic Pathology (AP) Specimen Tracking System to support end to end tracking of AP specimens, cassettes, and slides from accessioning through final disposition in alignment with the Federal EHR Baseline and Oracle Health Commercial Model. 1.2 The solution shall fully support high volume AP laboratory operations, including complex workflows and telepathology/digital pathology use cases. 1.3 The AP Specimen Tracking System shall have pre existing Oracle Health CareAware device drivers and pre existing integration with Oracle Health Advanced Barcoding and Tracking (AB&T); custom development of CareAware drivers or AB&T integration for the proposed product is out of scope for this effort. 1.4 The proposed AP Specimen Tracking System shall demonstrate a production implementation of CareAware and AB&T integration with Oracle Health in a hospital AP environment. 1.5 The system shall support barcode driven workflows to reduce manual data entry, minimize typographical errors, and improve patient safety, including support for multiple patient identifiers on blocks and slides consistent with applicable VA/VHA policy. 2.0 Scope 2.1 The AP Specimen Tracking System shall be utilized for all Anatomic Pathology and Cytology specimens within the Pathology and Laboratory Services at the following sites: St. Louis Pathology and Laboratory Services Kansas City Pathology and Laboratory Services Marion Pathology and Laboratory Services The Contractor shall provide services and support at the locations identified in this Statement of Work. The Government reserves the right to add, remove, or modify locations and facilities as mission requirements evolve across the current and future operational footprint. The Contractor shall accommodate these changes within the scope of the contract without disruption to services. Any adjustments to pricing, schedule, or resources resulting from such changes shall be addressed through the appropriate contractual modification process in accordance with the applicable Changes clause. 2.2 The system shall support workflow at a minimum for accessioning, specimen receipt, grossing, embedding, microtomy, staining, slide distribution, sign out, archival, and pathologist workstations at each of the sites listed in Section 2.1. At the pathologist workstation, the system shall support pathologist review of digital and/or physical slide information and shall enable the pathologist to originate orders for additional stains and recuts as part of the sign out workflow. 2.3 The Contractor shall provide all necessary software and hardware (including required drivers) to support connectivity with the VA Federal EHR environment and related AP instruments, in accordance with Federal EHR Baseline and Oracle Health guidance, for all sites listed in Section 2.1. 2.4 The Contractor shall provide any ancillary components (for example, barcode scanners, label printers, workstations, and interfaces) required for the AP Specimen Tracking System to function as specified at each site. 2.5 Site specific details such as floor plans, existing equipment inventories, and local interface diagrams are provided in Attachment A. 3.0 Applicable Documents 3.1 The Contractor shall perform all work in accordance with the most current versions of, but not limited to, the following as applicable: Federal EHR Baseline guidance for Anatomic Pathology and AP specimen tracking. title: Ireland – Laboratory services – Sampling and Analysis of Private Water Supplies in County Wexford
description: As the Supervisory authority for small private regulated water supplies in Wexford, Wexford County Council is required to monitor certain group water schemes and private premises which have their own wells, including caravan parks, schools, estates etc. The drinking water is sampled and analysed in accordance with S.l. No. 99/2023 - European Union (Drinking Water) Regulations 2023. Results are reported to Wexford County Council each month. The current compliance sampling contract ends on December 31st, 2026, and Wexford County Council is requesting tenders from interested parties for provision of these services. The service provider will be required to provide the following services: a) Compliance (and occasional investigative) sampling and analysis of drinking water for both 'check' and 'audit' parameters as set down by S.I. No. 99/2023 - European Union (Drinking Water) Regulations 2023 and listed in Appendix 1 Requirements and specifications. b) Occasional investigative sampling. These are normally duplicate samples i.e coliforms, e.coli free and total chlorine. Other parameters may also be asked for. c) In accordance with EPA requirements, all analysis of parameters in compliance samples (except for free and total chlorine, odour and taste and Dalapon) shall be accredited. Investigative samples do not have to be accredited. d) Reporting of results to Wexford County Council as detailed in Appendix 1 Requirements and specifications. There are currently about 170 private and group water supplies (Entities). This number is variable. It is expected that up to 15 additional schemes will be added during 2026 and these additional entities shall be sampled and analysed at tender rates. Each scheme shall have two check samples carried out annually. A small number of schemes will have more than two check samples and/or will require an audit sample. The level of analysis, including Limits of Detections must meet the requirements cited in S.I. No. 99/2023 - European Union (Drinking Water) Regulations 2023. The laboratory appointed (and/or sub contracted laboratory) must be accredited to !NAB (or equivalent) for all relevant parameters.

title: France – Technical building-inspection services – AMU89-2026 CONTRÔLE TECHNIQUE OPÉRATIONS DE RÉNOVATIONS LOURDES CAMPUS DE SAINT-CHARLES ET SAINT-JEROME A MARSEILLE
description: LOT 1 – Rénovation intérieure du bâtiment 5 sur le campus de Saint-Charles. Le projet concerne principalement le bâtiment 5 mais impactera aussi les bâtiments 6, 11 et 12 du site Saint-Charles (Campus Marseille Centre), situé en hypercentre de la ville de Marseille, à quelques minutes à pied de la gare TGV Saint-Charles. Entre 2022 et 2023, le bâtiment 5 fait l’objet d’une opération importante de rénovation pour en améliorer les performances énergétiques et le confort des usagers. Des travaux d’isolation des façades et de modernisation de certaines installations techniques (changement des menuiseries, ITI façade sud et ITE ailleurs, passage en VMC double flux des grandes salles de classe et TD) sont réalisés. La présente opération est comme une seconde phase qui s’attèle cette fois à l’intérieur des locaux, en recherchant une amélioration fonctionnelle et une meilleure adéquation des locaux aux activités universitaires, ainsi qu’une mise aux normes (normes IGH, sécurité incendie, accessibilité). Le bâtiment 12 étant imbriqué avec le bâtiment 5, il est intégré au projet à la fois fonctionnellement et techniquement. L’objet de l’opération est de regrouper dans ces deux bâtiments des locaux tertiaires modernisés pour plusieurs directions et services centraux d’amU, des locaux d’enseignement général et scientifique (salles banalisées, salles de TP Sciences, salles informatiques, laboratoires de langues), et des espaces de travail pour les étudiants et les enseignants. Enfin, l’opération prévoit la création d’une Maison de l’Etudiant avec un pôle de locaux aux services des étudiants et de la vie étudiante. Cette Maison de l’Etudiant prendra place au rez-de-chaussée et au R+1 du bâtiment 05, et dans le bâtiment Pouillon (bâtiment 6 situé en entrée de campus). La vie étudiante sera dynamisée par la démolition de l’actuelle mais vieillissante cafétéria (bâtiment 11) et l’installation d’une nouvelle cafétéria au rez-de-chaussée du bâtiment 5, au centre d’autres locaux de vie étudiante. LOT 1 : le présent marché prend effet à la date de sa notification pour une durée de 48 mois. LOT 2 – Opération campus Saint-Jérôme Le projet concerne 3 bâtiments : - TPR (M101-05) : Plus vaste édifice expérimental d’Aix-Marseille Université, le bâtiment TPR, construit en 1964, se présente sous forme de peigne composé d’une barre de distribution et de cinq ailes perpendiculaires. Édifié selon une structure poteaux-poutres de six niveaux, il développe une surface de 45 800 m² SHON, soit 40 % de la surface totale du site. Il regroupe dix unités de recherche, des locaux d’enseignement (ERP catégorie 2 type R), des services administratifs et des logements de fonction. - Bibliothèque universitaire (M101-38) : Équipement central pour la formation scientifique sur une surface de 6100m2, la BU, ERP catégorie 3 type S, se distingue par une ossature en poteaux et de larges façades vitrées éclairant un volume intérieur sur deux niveaux, articulé autour d’une mezzanine. Elle accueille les collections, des espaces de travail modulables et des salles pédagogiques innovantes. Deux logements d’astreinte sont implantés en rez-de-jardin. - Bâtiment Fresnel (M101-43) : Le bâtiment Fresnel est un bâtiment dédié à la recherche et n’accueillant pas de public, construit en 1964, reprend le principe constructif des ailes du TPR : trame poteaux-planchers. Plus compact, il constitue une unité autonome accueillant des activités de recherche sur 5100m2.Durée : LOT 2 : le présent marché prend effet à la date de sa notification pour une durée de 60 mois.
